name: Harsh Agarwal
headline: I build recommendation systems by day and argue about *Barça* by night.
intro: I'm a data scientist at Newme in Bengaluru, working on ranking and recommendations. Before that I spent two years at Zomato building recommendation, churn and growth models for the dining business.
I studied Electrical Engineering at IIT Delhi.
Outside work: Barcelona, Valorant, coffee, and trips I keep promising to write up properly.
